## Goal

Adopt the owner-supplied roadmap dated 1 October 2026. Launch Storefront + Digital Menu and the necessary Core first; replace the seven-module/17-week release plan with M0–M7 outcome milestones.

## Deliverables

- Current English roadmap, preserved historical roadmap, and traceable decision.
- Aligned charter, contribution rules, documentation index, glossary, and research applicability notes.
- Updated GitHub milestones and execution issues without erasing historical evidence.

## Done when

- No active document or tracker promises seven modules in v1.0 or the former calendar.
- M0–M2 are preparation; M3–M5 construction; M6 real pilot; M7 commercial launch.
- Future modules remain unscheduled; no commercial validation or implementation is claimed.
- Documentation checks pass and a reviewable PR is available.

﻿## Goal
Design the experience and the visual system before implementation.

## Deliverables
- Information architecture of the guest surfaces and the owner panel
- Critical flows: view menu, book a table, run today's service
- Low-fidelity wireframes + quick test with 2-3 people
- docs/design/art-direction.md (moodboard and documented style decision), product identity (logo, palette, typography, tone) and minimal Valiris studio identity
- Design system: tokens, base components, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, RTL readiness
- High-fidelity screens for the core, M2 and M3

## Done when
- Design system and key screens reviewed by the product owner

﻿## Goal
Validate the problem with evidence before defining the product.

## Deliverables
- docs/research/market.md - Spanish restaurant market, digitalisation, cost of no-shows (sources cited)
- docs/research/competitors.md - feature/pricing matrix: Qamarero, EterSystem, TheFork, CoverManager, Google Reserve, QR menus, loyalty apps
- docs/research/review-mining.md - at least 50 public competitor reviews classified by pain theme
- docs/research/interviews/ - Mom Test script + 2-3 simulated owner interviews (clearly labelled as simulated)
- docs/research/legal.md - GDPR/LOPDGDD, LSSI, allergens (EU 1169/2011), Google review policy, WhatsApp Business policy, PSD2/SCA
- docs/research/synthesis.md - prioritised problems with evidence, jobs-to-be-done, differentiation hypothesis

## Done when
- Gate 1 (problem validated) is passed and recorded in synthesis.md
